title: Thai Sausage Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish, wrapping a sausage, delight, and kabanos in a crispy wrap.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the sausage slices for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the kabanos slices for 1-2 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Warm the wrap in the grill or grill pan for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked sausage, kabanos, and delight in the center.
Add any desired toppings, such as sliced onions, cilantro, or sriracha.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
